picks.headline: Unit 42 Introduces Behavioral Clustering for Cloud Identity Threat Detection
picks.why: Provides an operational detection mechanism to map cloud identity roles from audit logs and spot compromised identities via SQL queries.
picks.title: Unmasking Cloud Identities: From Behavioral Clustering to Automated Detection

picks.headline: s-MDM Enables Zero-Trace Side-Channel Attacks Across Hardware Variants
picks.why: Demonstrates how generative modeling can synthesize cross-device side-channel profiles to break cryptographic hardware target portability barriers.
picks.title: s-MDM: Generative Virtualization of Multi-Device Hardware Variations for Portable DL-SCA

picks.headline: FL+FSDP Hybrid Sharding Reduces Interconnect Overhead in Pre-Training
picks.why: Combines federated averaging with sharded data parallelism to accelerate foundation model pre-training across constrained network topologies.
picks.title: Accelerating Sharded Data Parallelism at Scale with Federated Learning

picks.headline: Alignment Midtraining Fails to Enforce Robust Rules at 110B Scale
picks.why: Reveals fundamental limits in midtraining alignment techniques when evaluated against out-of-distribution prompts and unmonitored safety rules.
picks.title: Stress-testing Alignment Midtraining

papers.headline: Chronicle Enables Cut-Point Replay for LLM Agent CI Testing
papers.why: Records non-deterministic agent boundaries into deterministic envelopes to make LLM agent regression testing fast and reproducible in standard CI pipelines.
papers.title: Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents

papers.headline: Terminal Verifiers Catch 61% of Invalid LLM Agent Task Completions
papers.why: Shows that cheap read-only verifiers costing under a penny per episode can drastically improve stateful agent reliability without retraining.
papers.title: How Do Agent Harnesses Create Value? Planning Information and Release Control in Stateful LLM Agents

papers.headline: LLM Deliberation Groups Overstate Consensus Rates by Up to 44 Percentage Points
papers.why: Highlights a critical failure mode in multi-agent deliberation where models rapidly converge on unanimous but incorrect conclusions.
papers.title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task
